scan_rejection_scope: supplied withheld scans only; multiple reasons per token; not independent opportunities
qualification_count_scope: most-complete single homogeneous cohort; cohorts never pooled
selection_policy: earliest source-replayed forecast per model/reviewed dependency group, selected before labels

validation.score_scope: per homogeneous verified model cohort only
limitations: Independent features, independent source lineages and independent event groups are different requirements
No monetary mark or terminal quote can substitute for a verified settlement outcome
Multiple models sharing one parent do not create additional independent events

execution_economics.reason: forecast calibration alone cannot verify costs, executable edge or admission

snapshot_scope: only supplied original studies; an outcome without its origin cannot qualify

archive_scope.count_scope: total_studies is P18 only; included_studies also includes additive early native-check attempts

outcome_rule: Exact immediate-YES final-minute hit permits a native check; every label still requires finalized settlement proof
maturity_count_scope: completed reference windows or independently verified early terminal labels; reference hits alone never counted as finalized
pending_resolution_rule: completed-minute YES condition OR completed no-hit reference day, PLUS exact native finality; no price labels

sii_comparison.reason: frozen trained SII challenger, causal relationship evidence and verified event-disjoint outcomes required
sii_comparison.scope: current research policy has no challenger; no retrospective SII probabilities synthesized
